storage.heading: Where should Nimi store its files?
storage.subline: Nimi runs AI on your computer and keeps its models and data in one folder, all on this device. We've filled in a recommended spot — use it, or pick your own.
storage.preparing: Getting Nimi ready on this computer…

localAi.heading: Set up your local AI
localAi.detecting: Checking this device in the background…
localAi.unavailable: No admitted local plan for this level.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.subtitle: Adds local embeddings and image generation

setup.heading: Setting up Nimi…
setup.subline: This may take a few minutes. You can relax.

repair.heading: Nimi needs to repair a component
repair.body: A required local component needs repair before normal use. Retry the setup or run a repair to restore it.

blocked.heading: Nimi cannot continue safely
blocked.body: Setup cannot continue safely on this device right now. Contact Support to resolve the blocking cause.

not_logged_in.title: Sign in to use Nimi.
not_logged_in.body: Normal product use starts after an authenticated account session exists.

config_missing.title: Nimi is creating its local product record.
config_missing.body: This is an internal setup step. Data location selection appears after the product record exists.

data_root_missing.title: Choose where Nimi stores models, apps, and large local data.
data_root_missing.body: Use an absolute folder path. Nimi creates models, dependencies, apps, logs, audit, and cache roots there.

data_root_selected.title: Nimi is checking this device.
data_root_selected.body: The selected data root is recorded. Choose a local install level before heavy setup starts.

ai_environment_unconfigured.title: Choose how much of the local Nimi environment to install.
ai_environment_unconfigured.body: Minimal and Recommended are local-only baselines. Cloud connectors remain post-initialization settings.

local_ai_profile_selected_assets_missing.title: Nimi is downloading and verifying required local models and dependencies.
local_ai_profile_selected_assets_missing.body: Runtime-owned materialization progress must finish before normal product use opens.

local_ai_profile_selected_environment_no.title: Nimi is preparing its managed local environment.
local_ai_profile_selected_environment_no.body: Runtime activation evidence is still missing or incomplete.

local_ai_assets_downloaded_environment_n.title: Nimi has the files, but the local environment still needs repair.
local_ai_assets_downloaded_environment_n.body: The local assets are present, but activation has not produced ready evidence.

local_ai_ready.title: Nimi is finishing your default AI setup.
local_ai_ready.body: Account Default Profile, built-in AIConfigs, and baseline execution evidence still need finalization.

repair_required.title: Nimi needs to repair a required local component before normal use.
repair_required.body: Repair must restore the missing product-control, data-root, Runtime, profile, or execution evidence.

blocked.title: Nimi cannot continue safely yet.
blocked.body: Resolve the blocking cause, then Nimi will re-evaluate the first-run state machine.

ready_for_use.title: Nimi is ready.
ready_for_use.body: Normal product use opens to Chat and Nimi Chat.

errors.dataRootMissing: Choose a folder for Nimi before continuing.
errors.dataRootPickFailed: Failed to open the folder picker.
errors.installLevelRequired: Choose an install level to continue.
errors.installLevelNoProfile: {{installLevel}} has no admitted local first-run AIProfile.
